name: Omakase Table

menus.name: omakase
menus.note: About six small bites, eleven seasonal nigiri, tamago, a hand roll and dessert; changes daily; a 20% service charge is added

alsoTry.name: 788 Omakase Table
alsoTry.note: Sister counter in West Midtown (788 West Marietta St NW) with a 14-course menu

bookingOpens: Online on Resy, for parties of up to six. Each month's tables are released on the 2nd of the month before at 9am; members of the waiting list get early access on the 1st.

bookingWindow.note: Members of its waiting list get early access on the 1st.

cancellation: Cancellations within 48 hours, no-shows and cutting the number of guests are charged the full menu price per person.
walkIns: Reservations only; the restaurant is cashless.
groups: Buyouts and private events by enquiry to the restaurant.
